#!/bin/bash

START=$1
END=$2

if [[ ! $START =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ || ! $END =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
  exit 2
fi

if [[ $START == $END ]]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi

if [[ $START > $END ]]; then
  START=$END
  END=$START
fi

HOLIDAYS=$(cat /app/holidays.txt | grep -E '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' | sort -u)

WORKDAYS=0

for (( d=$START; d<$END; d++ )); do
  if [[ $d =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
    if [[ $(date -d $d +%u) -ne 7 && $(date -d $d +%u) -ne 1 ]]; then
      if [[ ! $(echo $HOLIDAYS | grep -E $d) ]]; then
        WORKDAYS=$((WORKDAYS + 1))
      fi
    fi
  fi
done

echo $WORKDAYS
